scope.rule: topologies.SCOPE (2026-11-18): EP <= 16 and <= 16 GPUs per engine / EP domain; priority = deployed + EP<=16 frontier; cover = rest of SCOPE (weight 0); out_of_scope = EP64/EP32 rows kept for id continuity (priority OOS, never benched)
scope.regimes: prefill F=16384 L=78.4K (5,456 fresh/request); decode r in {1,8,32} k=3 L=135K (r = requests per GPU, B_group = r*N, T_group = B*(1+k)); r above r_max dropped

megamoe_target: megamoe cases: t_ach_kernel_us = on-GPU compute ops only (dispatch/fc1/act/fc2/combine SIMT+MMA); t_ach_fused_us = that + P11 + P12 achievable NVLink time of the same step. A whole-kernel MegaMoE measurement is divided by t_ach_fused_us; the P11/P12 comm cases of an EP topology are then NOT benched separately for the derating (their d = the MegaMoE d).
id_rule: stable ids from ids_v1.json; id_new marks cases added after v1
priority_rule: use score = share_of_step_ach x (gap_prior - 1) / (regimes of that topology+ckpt), so every (topology, ckpt) weighs the same; share = count x max(t_ach, 0.78us kernel gap) / step_ach (comm: t_ach x layers, async included). Tiers per phase: P0 = cases covering the first 60% of that phase's total score, P1 to 90%, P2 the rest; a case takes its better tier. rank = by the larger of its phase score fractions. gap_prior = measured / model-achievable step of that topology (proxies marked).
